⚡️🇷🇺🇺🇦 A rare footage of the Russian jet-powered Geran-5 loitering munition/cruise missile over Ukraine, this time over Chernihiv, with the strike reportedly targeting a warehouse.
Footage documenting Geran-5 strikes has become increasingly frequent in recent weeks, suggesting that the system is moving beyond its initially limited deployment and is being fielded at a growing rate.

events.text:
✡️🇮🇱 From the West Bank to Syria: how Israel uses herds to seize land
Israel has quietly introduced a herd of 140 cattle onto Syrian land near the Golan Heights, using what appears to be a rural outpost to expand its territorial grip under the cover of agriculture.
🔴 Israeli forces have erected approximately 22 kilometers of fencing, some of it electrified, and have placed the land under military protection
🔴 IDF officers directly guided operations, providing settlers with marked locations of land for seizure
🔴 Syrian farmers report that they have been cut off from their land, with the military firing at anyone who approaches
This operation mirrors a strategy perfected in the West Bank, where so-called "shepherding outposts" have been used to claim land. According to the Syrian monitor Sijil, these methods have facilitated the takeover of over 10,000 hectares in the West Bank, close to a fifth of the entire territory. The practice has displaced Palestinians across 97 communities and areas since January 2023, most of them Bedouin and herding communities.
👉 The economic impact has been devastating. Farmers have been forced to sell livestock, take on debt, and, in some cases, sell personal assets just to cover basic needs.
The Syrian monitoring group Sijjil documented 187 violations in July and 239 in June, ranging from ground incursions to raids. Locals stress that tactics are designed to create an environment that drives people out.
The land seizure is part of a broader Israeli strategy to reshape the region. The "Greater Israel" project, which has been openly discussed by Israeli leaders, envisions expanding borders to include territory in Jordan, Lebanon, Syria, Egypt, and Iraq.
